article.hook: The walls around your choices start cracking under pressure. Pluto in Aries pushes us to strip away hesitation and get straight to impact, whether it’s ready or not.
article.lived: For close to two decades, this transit rewires how power moves through action. You notice it in the abrupt pivot at meetings, the sudden decision to cut through red tape, the flare-ups when patience runs out. Everyone feels the push to act directly and reshape their corner of the world with speed, not delay.
article.turn: That push sharpens into obsession when control slips through clenched fists. The drive to lead becomes a rush to dominate, and fast decisions turn into bulldozing other voices. Transformation dies when impatience crushes reflection.
